ddl:
-- Teaching contract d01-d03-v1 (2026-09-28). Apply only to the owned lab database.
CREATE TABLE users (
    id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    login varchar(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    CONSTRAINT users_login_nonblank CHECK (length(btrim(login)) > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE projects (
    id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name varchar(120) NOT NULL,
    created_by bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT projects_name_nonblank CHECK (length(btrim(name)) > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE project_members (
    project_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    user_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    role varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, user_id),
    CONSTRAINT project_members_role_valid CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'member'))
);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
    id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    created_by bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    title varchar(120) NOT NULL,
    description varchar(2000),
    status varchar(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo',
    minutes integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    due_at timestamptz,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT tasks_title_nonblank CHECK (length(btrim(title)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT tasks_status_valid CHECK (status IN ('todo', 'doing', 'done')),
    CONSTRAINT tasks_minutes_nonnegative CHECK (minutes >= 0)
);

users.login: varchar(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE, case-sensitive, btrim nonblank

projects.name: varchar(120) NOT NULL, btrim nonblank
projects.created_by: bigint NOT NULL FK users.id RESTRICT

project_members.project_id: bigint NOT NULL FK projects.id RESTRICT
project_members.user_id: bigint NOT NULL FK users.id RESTRICT

tasks.project_id: bigint NOT NULL FK projects.id RESTRICT
tasks.created_by: bigint NOT NULL FK users.id RESTRICT
tasks.title: varchar(120) NOT NULL btrim nonblank
tasks.status: varchar(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT todo CHECK todo/doing/done
tasks.minutes: integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK >=0 (retained estimate extension)
tasks.updated_at: timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; application updates explicitly

evolution.id: DB identity, not the H-series in-memory allocator; no automatic import
evolution.title: retained with database constraints
evolution.minutes: retained estimate for aggregation/concurrency, not a capstone mandatory field
evolution.done: replaced by status: false->todo, true->done; doing is new
evolution.note: renamed description, NULL means not supplied, empty string is supplied-but-empty

orm_handoff: Use identical SQLAlchemy table/column/constraint names and bigint identity mapping
Use timezone-aware DateTime for timestamptz; updated_at is not automatic
Project+owner membership is one transaction; no nested commit inside repository helper
Auth columns are deliberately absent, add with later migrations rather than fake password defaults
FK existence does not imply membership/authorization; no cross-project auth claim
At least/exactly one owner and creator-is-owner are service invariants, not fully enforced by this DDL
ON DELETE RESTRICT everywhere; teach ordered explicit child deletion later
btrim default removes ASCII spaces only; app may reject broader Unicode whitespace; do not claim equivalence
